messages:
harper: FYI from the periodic access review - found ~9 service accounts with cloudkms.* across multiple projects, several ownerless and unused for >200d. flagged as high entropy/admin drift. :warning:

drew: can you paste the query you used so we can reproduce and attach to the ticket?

harper: ran against BigQuery export of CloudAuditLogs:```sql
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS principal, resourceName, COUNT(*) as hits
FROM `redwood-audit.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_*`
WHERE protoPayload.serviceName='cloudkms.googleapis.com'
  AND TIMESTAMP(protoPayload.timestamp) > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 180 DAY)
GROUP BY principal, resourceName
HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
ORDER BY hits DESC;
```

maggie: thanks. my guess: old onboarding jobs and a few forgotten infra svcaccts got blanket roles. prefer key-level rebinds rather than org-role revokes.

kai: agree. propose triage buckets: SAFE (no prod binds), CANARY (non-prod low-traffic), BLOCK (prod-critical). do canary first with conditional binding to reduce blast radius.

drew: what signals for canary?

harper: primary signals: KMS AccessDenied by principal, decrypt failures surfaced in app logs, SetIamPolicy events (unexpected rebinds), and pager noise. thresholds: any AccessDenied >3 in 30m OR >5 decrypt failures in 24h = rollback.

maggie: steps to preserve audit evidence: 1) snapshot current key policy and save to gs://redwood-audit/kms-snapshots/${thread_ts}/pre-policy.json 2) commit runbook entry with commit SHA and ticket ID 3) tag snapshot with runbook id.

harper: exact commands we plan to run (examples):```bash
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/rk/cryptoKeys/master-key > pre-policy-${thread_ts}.json
gsutil cp pre-policy-${thread_ts}.json gs://redwood-audit/kms-snapshots/${thread_ts}/pre-policy.json
# to temporarily restrict access (instead of immediate revoke)
# add conditional binding that expires after canary window
gcloud kms keys set-iam-policy projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/rk/cryptoKeys/master-key policy.json
```policy.json snippet:```yaml
bindings:
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
  members:
  - 'serviceAccount:svc-canary@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com'
  condition:
    title: canary-window
    expression: request.time < timestamp("2026-04-10T00:00:00Z")
```

drew: good. for rollback we'll re-add prior binding with add-iam-policy-binding using the saved pre-policy if needed. please ensure pre-policy blob is immutable.

maggie: compliance wants a 2-3 bullet justification for each removed entitlement. draft template: - prior_role_blob: gs://redwood-audit/kms-snapshots/${thread_ts}/pre-policy.json - observed_risk: cross-project exposure / ownerless account / no recent usage - mitigation_plan: rebind to scoped key + rotate master + phased rollout - verification: no AccessDenied spikes, all consumer jobs green for 48h.

kai: scheduling: propose canary start 2026-04-08T16:00:00Z (10:00 PT) on svc-canary-01 (non-prod) for 24h. sec-bot can create the scheduled watch and pager thresholds.

sec-bot: scheduled: KMS least-priv canary for thread 3867003210, start=2026-04-08T16:00:00Z, owners=[maggie], alerts=[AccessDenied>3/30m, decrypt_fail>5/24h].

drew: another risk: automation that reapplies bindings (sync jobs). we should scan for SetIamPolicy actors and add a deny-marker check to the sync job before we run any removals. query to find rebind actors:```sql
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS actor, protoPayload.methodName, resourceName, TIMESTAMP(protoPayload.timestamp) as ts
FROM `redwood-audit.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_*`
WHERE protoPayload.serviceName='cloudkms.googleapis.com'
  AND protoPayload.methodName='SetIamPolicy'
  AND TIMESTAMP(protoPayload.timestamp) > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
ORDER BY ts DESC;
```

maggie: i'll patch the config-sync to skip keys with label `security:locked=true` and add an explicit audit line when it attempts to modify KMS bindings. kai please validate no infra automation will immediately rebind.

kai: will do. i'll also add a short-lived conditional binding as a protective measure while the sync is patched.

harper: action items: MAGGIE run canary + paste greps/logs to thread; KAI patch sync job and validate; DREW prepare compliance justification template and ticket; HARPER snapshot policies and update runbook. target decision by 2026-04-09 EOD. :lock: :white_check_mark:

audit-bot: recorded snapshot saved at gs://redwood-audit/kms-snapshots/3867003210/pre-policy.json by harper. ticket KMS-6120 created and linked.

drew: once canary is green we roll in batches (5/day) with weekly snapshots and automation to alert on any re-grants within 30d. also add an auto-incident if same principal regains cloudkms.* within 7d.

maggie: will post canary logs and the grep of AccessDenied events under gs://redwood-audit/kms-snapshots/${thread_ts}/canary-logs.txt. keeping this thread as the audit trail - please reply here only for any changes.
